# Privacy policy

Last updated: 19 November 2026. These words are a fixture of the tests, not the policy.

## What we keep

| Data | Where | For how long |
|---|---|---|
| Calls used this month | Cloudflare | Until the month ends |
| Devices | Cloudflare | Until you delete your account |

- Bills stay on your phone.
  - Photos never leave it.
- See the [terms](terms.md) and [what happens when you delete](#deleting-your-account).

## Deleting your account

Write to privacy@example.com, read [Anthropic's policy](https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy "Anthropic"), or go to [the page](/delete-account).
